tokenize_sentence: tokenize a sentence into lowercase word tokens using regex splitting with configurable keep and remove lists
build_vocabdict: build a VocabDict from a word list or file path with word to index and index to word mappings
build_vocabfromtext: build a VocabFromText vocabulary from a list of sentences with configurable minimum token count threshold
get_action_shortest_path: get the shortest path actions from a source to goal position in a HabitatSim simulation environment
generate_physics_config: generate a default physics configuration JSON file with bullet simulator settings if it does not exist
